messages.subject: Re: gsoc-r -- submission and work after deadline
parts:
Proposals must be submitted via Melange before the deadline. That's Google's call. We in
the R Project have no control over that.

However, we will likely allow students to complete tests or demonstrations of competence
with the coding they propose to do. Such checks that students are competent are more or
less required by Google, but it is up to mentors to arrange them and inform the rest of us
that students whose proposals we rank for funding are competent.

JN
